checks.finding: The full original HypothesesHprime, definite-inner-form base change, polarized attachment, local correspondence/classification, exact DescWeak, original reciprocity, full CohP and tied period inputs retain their explicitly stated scopes. Previously matched published applications are distinguished from foundations retained as original hypotheses. No new all-rank descent or foundational theorem is inferred from the bounded consumers.

HIA1 and HIA2 use the actual empty-level unitary datum and its IsJ to choose one J. Ring and dense come from JRP15/UPA18; pt/end1/end2/twist come from HPT18/HED16/HAW19/HTS8 with identical original arguments. No existential witnesses from unrelated ideals are combined. The J=B branch is included, and pt is correctly supplied by HPT18 rather than declared vacuous.

HED preserves all positive summand ranks and all positive Speh lengths. Its strict cofinite all-place root ratio is conditional on every string length being one. HAW preserves AutCsd0 without a continuity antecedent and places continuity only before WitOff. Its one real center is chosen before all eligible places for each attached cusp. The current narrative states these restrictions.

The all-positive-rank UpUW return is distinguished from PointTheoremBaseObject with its internal 2<=n<=4 antecedent, full inertia/flag/nonlinkage premises, and exact low-rank DescWeak use. The return proves J<=ker(x), rather than assuming it. TwistOk keeps its prescribed finite ell-power-order character, Good/type/depth guards and every local comparison; it uses the all-rank return and adds no all-rank DescWeak premise.

HLM supplies the actual directed union of original functions, exact fixed modules, integral quotient projectivity, all-level IsUniv/IsJ maps, one coherent universal action and vector-level classical separation. The old module equality and beta action comparison retain the same theta, type, residual data, fixed iota and ideal J. One base is chosen before every auxiliary V,h,q,v,w,Bq, including q=0.

HLM constructs the integral determinant before calling any point output that assumes it. The word computations occur in finite-degree truncated scalar algebras, and full polynomial laws are checked coefficientwise. Faithful-fiber comparison uses a positive-rank free summand before specialization; no arbitrary flatness is assumed. Prime3 and the original complete local coefficient scope are retained.

HTW preserves actual tame diagonal-unit terms and operator order, both full trace-polynomial relations, both comparison-map compositions equal to the exact ordered-pair fEl, and the exact coefficient-map identity. The exponent n! is uniform in auxiliary levels and is never inverted. Its formal-series, diamond quotient and completed splitting-algebra actions retain zero modules and empty families. The full abstract HasAutOfAlt is distinguished from the actual n>=1 installer.

HIA4 supplies the retained JSP11 inputs at the original rank-four test: actual normalization and detector choices, exact N4, common Kap.g=0, full pro-ell condition, coupled B1 parameter4[L+:Q]+4q and B2 constant0, selected Raw h=0,a=n=4, and the same-J HasAut. Pointwise finite extensions preserve the original kernel and do not enlarge the outer coefficient threshold.

HIA6 uses both actual QX Links with their common kappa,beta,t and distinct auxiliary primes. One coefficient threshold follows the fixed tower/iota and precedes every later coefficient DVR, Space, actual universal B and weight object. Each Link has its own J in its own ring; all six fields, HasAut and P1core refer to that same J within that ring. No equality between unrelated universal rings is asserted.

HIA5 matches the literal AutOffN/WitOff/WitA glueN interface. It keeps the same representation and iota, uses the two distinct underlying finite places only to choose an available strict window at each place, derives unlinked toral support, and uses HAW6 to choose one common center before all places. The two input centers need not agree.

HIA2 gives the entire original all-positive-rank HidaUAlt. Full ModularAlt/ModUAlt and arbitrary NiceE-chain P3core remain conditional on the explicit original PfromAut antecedent of HIA3. HIA4 uses only HIA3's unconditional noMu-to-residual-cyclotomic assertion. The conditional antecedent is explicitly marked as not an input to the selected closure; no arbitrary-Kap B1/B2 or Sel1=0 assertion is introduced.

The literal COUNT_II_SUPPORT contract is fully discharged at its stated original two-Link rank-four scope by HIA1–6 and the completed inherited support consumers. It is the only whole node whose category/kind/status/contract change. It becomes a class-B proved certificate. This is a closure within the selected human reconstruction under the retained named foundations, not a complete RH/GRH proof.

The selected graph has COUNT_II depending only on PMEX_ALT and its proved YX2 certificate, and PMEX_ALT depending only on COUNT_II_SUPPORT and its proved QX10 certificate. Thus HIA6 supplies the missing input to the inherited PMExAlt and CountII implications. Case II has been removed from the current remaining-input sentence while historical contracts remain preserved.

Compared the predecessor and current selected maps directly: all other node categories, kinds, statuses, contracts, requires, gates and bindings are unchanged. There remain30 whole obligations,21 C and9 B, with23 shared RH/GRH and7 additional Dirichlet-GRH and no RH-only item. The selected graph still has121 nodes and161 edges. This is a sufficient-route inventory, not a percentage or minimality claim.

The current continuation still requires the actual EtOne/reduction/inflation/Haar data, RowsAdd/RowsGood, one common AllRows and three sufficient cylinder counts; the already completed selected finite WeightAllRows theorem retains its original normalized-type/common-row inputs and eventual guard. The common geometric family, exact F3/F4 bridges, denominator/period/local-gain/spectral estimates, simultaneous selectors, one-character/congruence/RIG_II/CaseI/V and the additional GRH branches remain explicit.
